_comment: Release state per kernel and level (decision D14). `release` entries must stay within `_limits.release` times the instructions per sample of the comparison, `dev` entries within `_limits.dev`; `goal` marks the entries at or below it in the results. `info` entries are reported and never judged; their `waiver` text says why the comparison is not fair. A `waiver` on a `release` or `dev` entry names the open item in docs/open-items.md that tracks a limit that is not met yet; it never hides the numbers. The level `avx2-runtime` is judged against our own `avx2` numbers with `_limits.runtime`; entries for it are needed only to relax that. See docs/performance.md.
